title: Business setup
text: Register, get your numbers and get insured

tools.name: Northwest Registered Agent
tools.text: Forms your LLC and acts as your registered agent, so your home address stays private.

tools.name: IRS EIN
tools.text: Get your Employer Identification Number directly from the IRS. Free, and it takes ten minutes.

tools.name: Ownr
tools.text: The smoothest route to registering in Canada. Handles the name search and the filings.

tools.name: Zensurance
tools.text: Straightforward general liability for cleaners. Expect $60 to $80 a month to start.

title: Banking
text: Never mix business and personal money

tools.name: Novo
tools.text: Free business checking with a good mobile app.

tools.name: Mercury
tools.text: Online business banking with the cleanest dashboard.

tools.name: Relay
tools.text: Multi-user access and sub-accounts, useful for setting tax money aside.

tools.name: Chase Business Complete
tools.text: The pick if you deposit cash often and want a branch nearby.

tools.name: RBC Digital Choice
tools.text: Integrates with Ownr during registration, which can lower your setup cost.

tools.name: TD Business Unlimited
tools.text: A wide branch network across Canada.

title: Bookkeeping and payments
text: Pick by the stage you are at

tools.name: Stripe
tools.text: Connects to Crewty so client payments go straight to your account.

tools.name: Google Sheets
tools.text: All the bookkeeping you need while you are small.

tools.name: QuickBooks
tools.text: The standard for small business accounting once revenue picks up.

tools.name: Wave
tools.text: A lower cost alternative for simple books.

tools.name: Xero
tools.text: Clean accounting software that your bookkeeper will know.

tools.name: Wix
tools.text: The most beginner-friendly way to build your own site, $15 to $40 a month.

tools.name: Google Business Profile
tools.text: Your most important free marketing asset, and required for Local Service Ads.

tools.name: Google Local Services Ads
tools.text: Show up at the top of Google for people searching for a cleaner right now.

tools.name: Meta Ads
tools.text: The best targeting and creative options for cleaning. Start here with paid ads.

tools.name: CapCut
tools.text: Edit before and afters and time-lapses for Facebook, Instagram and TikTok.

title: Hiring
text: Where owners in the Discord find cleaners

tools.name: Care.com
tools.text: Cleaners who are already background checked.

tools.name: TaskRabbit
tools.text: A good backup when you need solo cleaners fast.

tools.name: Indeed
tools.text: Post a job and screen applicants with the ten minute phone screen.

tools.name: Facebook groups
tools.text: Local cleaning and job groups. Interview well, then test with a paid trial clean.
